description: Land Title Settlement Department - Elamalpe,  Weligepola D/S Division,  D/S Division, Rathnapura   District - Cad. Map No. 620170
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and ownership details) in various villages. The content focuses entirely on land registration, title determinations, and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There is no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative content.
